notes: 'where the king dwelleth' renders the construct מְקוֹם הַמֶּלֶךְ: 'where' is the recast relation and goes to the rectum headed on 'king', while the supplied lexical verb 'dwelleth' is added under rule 20's supplied-lexical-verb clause.

Both 'whose's fuse a written אֲשֶׁר with its resumptive suffix (rules 22, 30), and the 'even' before 'with him' is added, since אִתּוֹ is the preposition H854 and no marker stands on that phrase (rule 16).
אִם לֹא fuses to 'surely' with the first token as the deterministic anchor (rules 30, 6).
